title.narrative: Promoting environmental sustainability, gender equality, and land rights through permaculture and sustainable tourism in Kyrgyzstan

description.narrative: This activity supports community-based environmental sustainability, gender equality, and land and property rights in Kyrgyzstan through permaculture practices and sustainable tourism initiatives. The activity focuses on strengthening local capacities, particularly among women and rural communities, to manage natural resources sustainably, improve livelihoods, and promote inclusive decision-making related to land use and environmental governance. It builds on El Too’s long-term work in the region and combines practical training, community engagement, and awareness-raising to support locally driven, environmentally sustainable development.
